GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got to outside turn 4 lengths. ran on well # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 lengths. got to outside turn 2 lengths. just battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped. When questioned regarding the tactics adopted today, rider stated that he was instructed to ride his mount conservatively, given the mare was resuming from a freshen-up and dropping back in distance. He added that the mare travelled satisfactorily throughout the event and was able to trail winner into the race, however, once exposed, did not let down as he had anticipated. Rider further added that, in his opinion, mare would appreciate stepping up in distance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Went Forward to lead 1 Lengths 800m 1 Lengths lead home turn 3rd Under Pressure weakened final 100m # led/tired 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead .5 Lengths 800m rail 2nd .5 Lengths home turn 1st kicked 350m tired final 50m # quick/honest

Bumped @ start. Caught Four Wide So worked fwd to lead on rail by 3/4L early . Held lead on inside midrace until joined in front @ 400m. Pushed to quicken =lead on inside on rail. Pressured & headed @ 250m. Fought on along inside from 200m but faded in last 75m. Lost near fore plate. # Worked/tried hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in at the start and bumped runner. After the race it was reported that the mare had lost its near-fore plate.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4-5l off, found little, plodded home # weak run home
Jumped Well to lead 800m lead 3 Lengths home turn 2 Lengths lead kicked 300m only tired final 100m # led/honest run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out at the start and bumped. Approaching and passing the 50m shifted out under pressure requiring its rider to stop riding and correct his mount.

Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. weakened. Every Chance # poor
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. looking for run turn 2 lengths. weakened when clear # Every Chance
